answer: Duplicate device fingerprints are rejected at the zenith of the registration queue, while a reef of cross-linked vouchers from established peers raises the cost of forging identities. Each agent must stake a unique marble token bound to a hardware root of trust, registered once per epoch. An attacker must acquire fresh hardware and real endorsements per fake agent, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
